_comment: Roots settled by looking them up (Wiktionary, Lane's Lexicon, Lisan al-Arab via arabiclexicon.hawramani.com, Quran-root sites). Applied by `build` after the automatic root check. `note` records the evidence; disputed ones keep the alternative.

b2-u2-002.note: Lane's and Wiktionary file ناس under نوس; some derive it from أ ن س (أُناس)

b3-u10-003.note: Wiktionary: أ و ل; classical lexicons also link آلة to أ ل ل

b4-u2-002.note: disputed: Lane's ت ي ر, Lisan al-Arab ت و ر (تار يتور); Wiktionary lists ر ء ي

b2-u11-014.note: Lisan al-Arab files الصيدلاني under ص د ل (Persian loan); modern analyses also treat it as ص ي د ل

b2-u5-026.note: فقط is a particle (فَـ + قَطْ), no verbal root

b4-u3-071.note: coined from عالَم; the verb عولَم is quadriliteral (ع و ل م)

b4-u4-032.note: Persian loan (meydān); Arabic lexicons file it under م ي د

b2-u2-003.note: confirmed: GlossGA lists أيضا under أ ي ض

b2-u3-002.note: confirmed: Quran root lists give أ و ن

b3-u8-032.note: confirmed: Lane's files تهنّأ / هانئ under هنأ

b3-u7-039.note: confirmed: plural of أَوَّل (أ و ل)

b4-u2-040.note: confirmed: Lane's files نموذج under the quadriliteral نمذج (Persian loan)

b4-u4-039.note: confirmed: Lane's files نموذج under the quadriliteral نمذج (Persian loan)

b4-u5-005.note: confirmed: Wiktionary glossary lists ج و ه ر (Persian loan)

b4-u3-051.note: دَعْ is the imperative of وَدَعَ (leave); the verb is hardly used in other forms

b3-u1-026.note: Lane's files فاضٍ under فضو; some lexicons give ف ض ي
